fields.quote: It began on 7 August and is scheduled to end on 23 November 2026.
fields.note: Phase row: the Clausura, the third and final phase of the 2026 season (Apertura, Intermedio, Clausura); 23 November 2026 is its scheduled last matchday. Liverpool already won it with a match to spare. The championship play-off (semi-final, then a two-legged final) follows in December, outside this phase.

fields.quote: fecha de inicio = 13 de marzo de 2026
fields.note: The row is the whole Segunda División (14 clubs), not a phase, even though the database name says 'Torneo Competencia': the season article has one double round-robin of 230 matches. The earlier start (02-06) was wrong.
Month only, so the class default stays. A previous pass recorded 05-02 from the Torneo Competencia final (an opening tournament); that is not the end of the championship and was rejected.
